title: Repository-native Product Decision Journal
target_user: Small teams building web products with AI coding agents
problem: Product decisions, evidence, and implementation context drift across chats, documents, issues, and code changes.
solution_hypothesis: Keep product evidence, decisions, gates, and implementation context in the repository and make irreversible transitions human-gated.

decision.question: Should this idea be promoted from the Incubator into an independent Product Repository for deeper discovery?
